description: Find active canonical places near coordinates, optionally resolving historical context for a date.

date.description: Optional historical date in yyyy-MM-dd format; names and context are resolved as known on that date.

latitude.description: Required latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 through 90.

longitude.description: Required longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 through 180.

radiusKm.description: Optional positive search radius in kilometres. Defaults to 50.

take.description: Optional number of places to return, nearest first, from 1 through 20. Defaults to 20.

typeCode.description: Optional canonical place type code (see the place-type-catalog resource).

name: find_places_nearby
